title: Answer to Question: Regarding the Election Results
text:
Answer to Question Regarding the Election Results

Q1: No sooner had the election results shown the victory of the Congress Party than the former Italian nationality of the party's president, Sonia Gandhi, was raised, even though she had renounced that nationality and her nationality had become Indian, legally and properly. Her former Italian nationality was raised so blatantly that the deputies of the Janata Party threatened to walk out of the elected parliament in protest. This was followed by tugs-of-war that led Sonia to withdraw from nominating herself for the premiership. Does this mean that America has begun early to create troubles for the Congress Party from the very beginning of its term?

A1: Yes, this is correct. It is not easy for America to leave India to become once again a political "kitchen" for British influence in the Indian subcontinent. Therefore, the weightier view is that American fingers were behind the stirring up of Sonia's former nationality after her success in leading the Congress Party to victory in the elections.

To understand this clearly, let us go back a little. The Congress Party is known for its loyalty to the English; it was made under their eye. Among its most active presidents in entrenching British policy and standing in the face of American policy there was Nehru, and he was followed in that by the Gandhi family (Indira Gandhi, and her two sons Sanjay and Rajiv). America was in conflict with them. It is likely that America had a role in the assassination of Rajiv Gandhi. This is confirmed by the fact that the one who replaced him as prime minister was (Narasimha Rao), who is from the moderate ranks of the Congress Party, known for appeasing America, especially since he appointed (Manmohan Singh) as finance minister, a man known for encouraging American investment in India. This finance minister created economic relations with American capital, especially in the field of electronics. The fact that this same finance minister is the one nominated for the premiership in place of Sonia, and actually becomes prime minister, indicates that American pressures were behind that.

In any case, it is not easy for America to take hold of the Congress Party, for it is one of the pillars of the English. But America will not leave India easily after having penetrated it for a period of eight years. It will use whatever means it can, by enticement and intimidation, to try to penetrate the Congress Party, or to create troubles for it, or to try to penetrate the governing coalition through the small parties in coalition with Congress, and the like, because the Congress Party does not hold a majority by itself. However, we do not think it will succeed, because of the opposing British political cunning and the long-established standing of the Congress Party. Rather, Britain and the Congress Party may resort to political flexibility towards America, as is the habit of Britain's agents in the Middle East region, and indeed as is the habit of Britain itself in its policy towards America: it is soft with it outwardly and harasses it inwardly. Nevertheless, Britain, through the Congress Party, will not let any opportunity that presents itself to shake America's influence in the subcontinent, and especially in Pakistan, pass without seizing it, in an attempt to make Britain a partner with America in influence in the Indian subcontinent, if it cannot restore Britain's influence to what it was previously.

9 Rabi' al-Akhir 1425 AH
28/05/2004 CE
